sentences.text: ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Gokulesh Bohra For Respondent(s) : Mr. Gaurav Singh, PP
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 18/12/2023
The present bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
The petitioner has been arrested in connection with C.R. No.536/2019 registered at Police Station Mahamandir, District Jodhpur for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 406 and 409 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the offences alleged to have been committed by the petitioner are triable by Magistrate.
Challan of the case has already been presented.
The petitioner is in the judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time.
Therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.
[CRLMB-15408/2023] I have considered the arguments advanced before me and gone through the material available on record.

sentences.text: Taking into account the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner - Girdhar Singh S/o Khiv Singh, shall be enlarged on bail in C.R. No.536/2019 registered at Police Station Mahamandir, District Jodhpur provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for his appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 131-Rashi/-
